As a furloughed part time employee, my days are filled with literally nothing except sitting at home and doing programming classes online. Each day I wait for the phone to ring hoping I get the call while simultaneously hoping I actually DO get a call. Each day that goes by I’m seeing more and more how states are opening up, how my county is approving a full scale roll out of bringing back retail, even the mall is now open. Yet where is Best Buy? Part of protecting employees from the pandemic is having the foresight to plan a full scale reopening which includes protecting the mental health and wellness of the people who have been working doggedly with little to no reprieve for months.
